scope: HTTP sensor credential lookup, processing, and ClickHouse fallback failures

behavior.credential_lookup: Storage exception details are removed from logs and the 503 response remains bounded.
behavior.reading_processing: Processing failures log only the exception class and return the existing retryable 503 response.
behavior.clickhouse_fallback: The direct compatibility fallback logs only the exception class.
behavior.cleanup: Processing rollback and connection close behavior remain intact.

coverage: secret-bearing credential lookup failure is absent from logs and HTTP response
secret-bearing reading failure retains retryable 503 and cleanup without exposing details
secret-bearing ClickHouse fallback error is absent from logs

static_checks.database_or_provider_access: none; TestClient with mocked database, signature secret, and projection boundary

limitations: No live HTTP receiver, database, broker, or ClickHouse endpoint was used.
This does not establish network listener, TLS, rate-limit, or live device behavior.
